name: Transformers: EarthSpark
description: The Malto Family’s world turns upside down when the Terrans, the first Earthborn Transformers robots, spark to life. The Terrans will forge an alliance between the human Malto family and the legendary Autobots, uniting them in a shared mission.

videos.title: Secret Legacy (1) / Secret Legacy (2)
videos.overview: Robby has trouble adjusting after their family's big move to the rural town of Witwicky, until he and his sister, Mo, discover the first-ever Earthborn Transformers.

videos.title: Moo-ving In
videos.overview: As the Malto family get used to its new members, Bumblebee quickly learns that his mission to train the Terrans won't be as easy as he thought.

videos.title: House Rules
videos.overview: Thrash is impatient with the family rules and convinces Mo to push their boundaries. But when a Decepticon needs their help, Mo and Thrash find themselves playing by a far more dangerous set of rules.

videos.title: Classified
videos.overview: G.H.O.S.T. Special Agent Schloder pursues Twitch after mistaking her for a Deception. Meanwhile, Dot is put through G.H.O.S.T. orientation, where she learns that her employer's intentions may not be what they seem.

videos.title: Traditions
videos.overview: Robby backs out of Alex's traditional Wakwak hunt, so Alex shares his family history with Bumblebee, while Twitch, eager to gain her own traditions, encounters "Dad2" - Wheeljack.

videos.title: Family and Friends
videos.overview: The Terrans' erratic behavior may be affecting Mo and Robby's anxiety about their first day at their new school. Or it could be something far worse...

videos.title: Decoy
videos.overview: While out on a mission to capture three Mini-Cassette bots, Megatron and Optimus Prime have a disagreement about G.H.O.S.T.'s treatment of Decepticons.

videos.title: Age of Evolution (1) / Age of Evolution (2)
videos.overview: Twitch and Thrash wonder if they're the only Terrans on Earth. Their family, Optimus Prime, and Bumblebee help seek answers and find new allies! Meanwhile, Mandroid captures Dot and Megatron. Can the larger group become a team and save their friends?

videos.title: Hashtag: Oops
videos.overview: Twitch helps Hashtag choose her alt-mode, and it takes them both for a wild and G.H.O.S.T.-ly ride that Bumblebee must help them escape.

videos.title: Outtakes
videos.overview: Jawbreaker wonders how to choose the right alt-mode. He interviews other bots on camera to hear their perspectives. But when Hashtag gets involved, Jawbreaker's project loses focus.

videos.title: Missed Connection
videos.overview: When Nightshade's feeling isolated from the rest of the Malto family, they find a new connection in the most unlikely of places.

videos.title: Security Protocols
videos.overview: Bumblebee's past as an elite racecar driver is exposed and Special Agent Schloder is hot on his trail.

videos.title: Bear Necessities
videos.overview: Mother's Day goes wrong and the Maltos discover a toxic threat to Mother Earth.

videos.title: Warzone
videos.overview: Robby and Mo join the Terrans on a visit to the Spacebridge Memorial Park, but the memory of the siege opens old wounds...and more...for Megatron.

videos.title: Home (1) / Home (2)
videos.overview: The kids and Terrans sneak out for a night of fun in Philadelphia, but their dream of visiting the big city transforms into a nightmare.

videos.title: A Stygi Situation
videos.overview: Jawbreaker finally chooses an alt-mode, but instead of changing into it, the alt-mode changes him.

videos.title: Disarmed
videos.overview: Robby, Mo, and the Terrans attempt to unlock new Cybersleeve powers, with disastrous results.

videos.title: What Dwells Within
videos.overview: The Malto kids are lost in an underground maze of tunnels with a mysterious monster stalking them. To survive, they must team up with Starscream! But can they trust him?

videos.title: Prime Time
videos.overview: Feeling helpless as Robby's condition worsens, Mo wishes she had never touched the Emberstone. Quintus Prime shows the young hero that because of her, the world is a better place.

videos.title: Stowed Away, Stowaways
videos.overview: Optimus Prime suspects G.H.O.S.T. is hiding something and sends Bumblebee on a secret recon mission deep inside G.H.O.S.T. HQ. The young Maltos sneak in and help their mentor.

videos.title: The Battle of Witwicky
videos.overview: The truth about the Terrans is revealed as the Malto family makes a last stand against Croft and her sinister forces within G.H.O.S.T.

videos.title: Last Hope
videos.overview: The Malto family must overcome insurmountable odds to stop Mandroid once and for all and save Cybertronian kind.

videos.title: Aftermath
videos.overview: One year later… A new Terran is born!

videos.title: In Ruins
videos.overview: Mo and Thrash stumble upon ancient ruins and discover a mysterious creature inside.

videos.title: Control Alt Delete
videos.overview: Hashtag helps the Autobots get rid of all the old GHOST stuff around base, which has her feeling like her GHOST van alt-mode is obsolete, too. Meanwhile, Shockwave needs to acquire a GHOST hard drive that holds a key to Starscream's master plan.

videos.title: The Butterfly Effect
videos.overview: Robby meets his crush, and his siblings feel all his feels at the worst possible time.

videos.title: Togetherness
videos.overview: Left behind by his siblings, Jawbreaker finds a new friend and sticks close to him.

videos.title: Spitfire
videos.overview: Twitch welcomes a new Terran to the family…

videos.title: The Imposters
videos.overview: Spitfire takes from Twitch everything she loves most.

videos.title: Dude, Where's My Trailer?
videos.overview: Robby and Hashtag accidentally lose Optimus Prime’s favorite Trailer…

videos.title: Witwicky
videos.overview: Mo and Hashtag discover Witwicky’s biggest secret, but Starscream knows about it too…

videos.title: The Need for Read
videos.overview: Half of Witwicky is trapped under the Prime Dome. Robby wishes life would go back to normal, so Mo, Thrash, and Bumblebee team up to lift Robby's spirits and rescue what's stuck inside the chaotic Dome – but Bee has an ulterior motive…

videos.title: Attack of the Drive-In Movie
videos.overview: Robby invites Izzy to a drive-in movie, so all the Maltos tag along and go to extreme lengths to make it the best night ever – but their help transforms the movie's science fiction into science reality…

videos.title: The Great Escape
videos.overview: Robby, Mo, and the Terrans are invited to play Witwicky's new Escape Room game. Twitch loves to win, so she's eager to help her team succeed – but the game is much more than meets the eye…

videos.title: No Soldier Left Behind
videos.overview: An Autobot starship crash lands on Earth! The Autobots and Maltos must get there first to protect it – and whomever is inside – from the Decepticons…

videos.title: Fire and Ice
videos.overview: The Maltos enjoy a snow day while, back at Base, something has the Autobots in a red-hot rage… When Twitch gets caught in their frenzy – can she survive long enough to help her troubled friends?

videos.title: The Truth Is Out There
videos.overview: Prowl, Thrash, and Robby team up to solve the mystery of who is behind the recent attack on the Autobots. Thrash gets to flex his detective skills, and Robby finds evidence that’s out of this world… Will they find the culprit before the next attack?

videos.title: Judgment Day
videos.overview: On the worst day of Robby's life, he and Mo must fight for their lives against a new Invader who claims to be the rightful heir to Quintus Prime's power. The only way the Maltos and the Autobots can help is by putting their trust in unlikely allies…

videos.title: Hometown Heroes
videos.overview: Every victory has a cost, and now the Maltos must face those consequences. When Robby is caught abusing his powers, Mo and "Detective" Thrash team up to prove their brother's innocence, while Twitch becomes her own worst enemy.

videos.title: Legacy of Hope
videos.overview: The Maltos and Autobots search Cybertron for their missing allies. Thrash steps up to help his struggling sister lead this critical mission, but tension divides the team when they need unity most. Meanwhile, Robby and Mo find a new friend, and Optimus finds an old enemy.
